description: For infinite kappa, each column of an Ulam matrix contains a stationary cell after intersection with any stationary subset of kappa successor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.stationary_cell.{u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (M : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.UlamMatrix κ)
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ))) (hS : IsStationary S)
  (α : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ)) : ∃ i, IsStationary (S ∩ M.cell i α)
